brief: Is meant to hold a list of objects as a list of its own; it can not be built with a list today.
detail: Building it with a list of objects raises R14, because init calls IsListOfObjects on a stzList and that method does not exist; Content returns nothing; and Copy raises. Only the holder built without parentheses, as StzListOfObjectsQ() does, can be made, and it is empty. The class is a sketch whose file begins with a TODO. stzObjects is another name of it.
